title: Rust review conventions
summary: Read-only review guidance for Rust: ownership and lifetimes, error handling without panics, unsafe justification and test coverage. Rust implementation is not delegated.

provenance.notes: Review-only. The language adapters do not register Rust, so no worker receives this skill.

outputs.name: findings
outputs.description: Soundness, error handling and test findings with line references.

workflow.step: Find every unsafe block and check for a comment stating the invariant that makes it sound, and that the invariant is enforced by the surrounding type.
workflow.check: No unsafe block lacks a stated invariant.

workflow.step: Find unwrap, expect and panic paths in non-test code and judge whether the failure is truly impossible.
workflow.check: Library code returns Result instead of panicking.

workflow.step: Check ownership and lifetimes for needless clones, leaked references and shared mutable state without synchronization.
workflow.check: Shared state has a named synchronization strategy.

workflow.step: Check error types: they carry context and implement the standard traits; errors are not converted to strings early.
workflow.check: Callers can match on error kind.

workflow.step: Check tests cover failure paths, and note whether clippy and fmt expectations are met.

constraints: Read-only analysis; Rust implementation is not delegated to local workers.
Do not recommend removing unsafe without understanding why it is there.

examples.title: Unwrap in parser
examples.situation: A parser calls unwrap on user input.
examples.guidance: Report as high severity: malformed input panics the process. Return a typed error.

verification: Every finding cites a file and line.
Unsafe findings state the missing invariant.

task.text: Review the rust crate: unsafe block, unwrap and lifetime handling.
The cargo build fails with a borrow error in ownership of the result.
Review the unsafe and unwrap use.
